duration.$description: Motion durations (DESIGN.md section 8.1). instant is 1ms, not 0, so transitionend still fires; shimmer and spin formalise the two hardcoded loop timings.

ease.$description: Easing curves (DESIGN.md section 8.2): in for exits, out for entrances, in-out for moves, emphasised for energetic entrances.

transition.$description: Composite transition shorthands (DESIGN.md section 8.3), each a var() reference bundle so duration/ease overrides cascade. Usage: transition: var(--bw-transition-colors); never transition: all.

colors.$value: color var(--bw-duration-fast) var(--bw-ease-standard), background-color var(--bw-duration-fast) var(--bw-ease-standard), border-color var(--bw-duration-fast) var(--bw-ease-standard)
